name: SetResellerUserStatus

parameters.help_en:
The status to set for the user account. Valid values:
Freeze: The user account is frozen.
Thaw: The user account is restored.
Trusteeship: The user account is hosted.
TrusteeshipCancel: The user account is not hosted
parameters.help_zh:
需要设置的用户状态
取值：
    Freeze：用户冻结状态
    Thaw：用户解冻状态
    Trusteeship：用户托管状态
    TrusteeshipCancel：用户非托管状态
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The type of business operation. Valid values:
FREEZE: Freeze operations.
TRUSTEESHIP: Hosting operations
parameters.help_zh:
业务类型
取值：
    FREEZE：用户冻结业务
    TRUSTEESHIP：用户托管业务
parameters.name: business_type

parameters.help_en:
The stopping mode. Valid values:
0: Normal shutdown.
1: Immediate shutdown
parameters.help_zh:
停机模式
取值：
    0：普通停机
    1：立即停机
parameters.name: stop_mode
